method: 623 geographic candidates, named categories, branch/name research, visual identity checks and individual Commons author/license metadata. Geographic proximity alone never attached a photo.
remainingExplanation: No exact eligible photograph confirmed in this research. Some candidates had unresolved identity, unsupported reuse rights, or irrelevant subjects. Commons rate limits ended further API research; this is not a claim that no photographs exist elsewhere.

reviewedFiles.title: File:Esil District, Astana (P1190756).jpg

Commons camera coordinates 51.100961, 71.418616 are about 58m east of the OSM cafe 51.1008453, 71.4178111, facing that exact corner facade.
